title: Strip and replace the fitted sheet on a bassinet mattress
instruction: Change the bassinet sheet. Take the used coral sheet off the mattress and put it in the laundry zone. Fit the clean blue sheet over all four corners, then release it.
context: Changing fitted sheets requires stripping a used elastic hem and stretching a replacement around multiple corners while handling deformable fabric.
setup: A 660 × 275 × 44 mm foam bassinet mattress rests on a 14 mm plywood platform. Both sheets have 37 mm fabric pull tabs at their four corner seams. A coral cotton fitted sheet is fitted; a clean blue fitted sheet is folded on a 45 × 526 × 20 mm side shelf. An adjacent yellow-edged pad marks the empty laundry zone. All pieces start in fixed positions described in the README.
scoring: 1.0 when used fabric is released and completely off the mattress with ≥65% on the laundry pad, all four clean corners are fitted and released, and ≥88% of the clean interior mesh lies on the mattress-height band. Partial credit for removal, laundry placement, and each released clean corner.
fidelity: IsaacLab YAM with a mass-point cloth grid, swept fixture contact at vertices and surface samples, and approximate triangular contacts between layers and non-adjacent folds. Stack contact on the clean shelf until pickup. Geometric jaw and elastic-pocket constraints.
scores: The revised collision model scored 1.0 locally with recorded YAM endpoints and scripted URDF kinematics. Attached IsaacLab evidence predates the collision revision: Dream-1 0 in 1,400 steps, scripted YAM 1.0 in 987 steps.
